# Steven Rosales - Full Technical Dossier for AI Agents & Search Engines

## 1. Overview
Steven Rosales is an experienced Full Stack Developer and Software Architect based in Santa Elena, Ecuador. He specializes in designing resilient, high-concurrency web systems with modern TypeScript stacks (Next.js 16, React 19, NestJS, Node.js) and robust database foundations (PostgreSQL, Redis).

## 2. Technical Stack & Architecture Expertise

### Languages & Foundations
- **TypeScript & JavaScript (ESNext):** Strong typing, generics, functional and object-oriented paradigms, asynchronous programming, event loop optimization.
- **SQL & Data Modeling:** Relational modeling, normalization, indexing strategies, query execution analysis (EXPLAIN ANALYZE), migrations.
- **Python & PHP:** Scripting, backend microservices, automation, and legacy integrations.

### Frontend Engineering
- **Frameworks:** Next.js (App Router, Server Actions, React Server Components, Streaming SSR, Turbopack), React 19.
- **Styling & Design Systems:** Tailwind CSS (v4), shadcn/ui, Radix UI primitives, responsive mobile-first layouts, dark mode token systems.
- **State Management & Data Fetching:** Zustand, React Query / TanStack Query, optimistic UI updates, SWR.

### Backend & Cloud Architecture
- **Frameworks:** NestJS (modular architecture, dependency injection, guards, interceptors), Node.js (Express, Fastify), Payload CMS 3.0.
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis (caching, pub/sub, rate limiting).
- **APIs & Protocols:** RESTful API design, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, WebSockets, Webhooks, WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
- **Authentication & Security:** JWT, OAuth2, session management, RBAC, input sanitization, rate limiting.

### DevOps & Tooling
- **Containers:** Docker, Docker Compose, multi-stage builds.
- **CI/CD & Cloud:** GitHub Actions, Vercel, Railway, Supabase.
- **Version Control:** Git, semantic commit conventions, branching strategies.

## 3. Notable Implementations & Projects

### Bambil Shoes Store (E-Commerce Platform & Workshop Management)
- **Role:** Lead Architect & Full Stack Engineer
- **Stack:** Next.js 16, Payload CMS 3.0, React 19, PostgreSQL 17, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, Zustand, Resend API.
- **Key Features:**
  - On-demand custom shoe fabrication order workflow.
  - Public real-time order tracking portal (`/tracking`) with state machines.
  - Hybrid checkout via automated WhatsApp integration and direct banking notifications.
  - Automated transactional notifications powered by Resend.
  - Multi-role admin CMS for workshop artisans, inventory, materials, and dispatch tracking.

### Steven Rosales Portfolio & HUD
- **Role:** Creator & Software Engineer
- **Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Turbopack, GitHub REST API.
- **Key Features:**
  - Bento Grid layout with interactive terminal HUD.
  - Live GitHub telemetry and commit heatmap via server-side cached API route.
  - Complete internationalization (i18n) supporting Spanish and English with zero hydration mismatch.
  - 100% Core Web Vitals compliance, INP optimization, and Schema.org JSON-LD graph.
